controlled_comparison.different_geometric_metrics: Differences associated with geometric realization rather than graph connectivity; no broader causal claim is implied.
controlled_comparison.different_geometry_weighted_network_metr: Routing-cost consequences of changed edge lengths/geometries on otherwise controlled connectivity.
controlled_comparison.identical_topology_metrics: Evidence that experimental topology control was maintained.

core_metric_selection_rationale.geometry.mean_edge_circuity: Summarizes edge-level geometric deviation from chords.
core_metric_selection_rationale.geometry.mean_edge_length: Summarizes the scale of canonical physical edges.
core_metric_selection_rationale.geometry.network_circuity: Provides the length-ratio aggregate for the entire physical network.
core_metric_selection_rationale.geometry.total_length: Captures total realized street length on the fixed topology.
core_metric_selection_rationale.network_weighted.mean_shortest_path_leng: Summarizes routing cost when physical edge lengths weight the controlled graph.
core_metric_selection_rationale.orientation.chord_entropy: Measures directional dispersion with one equally weighted chord per edge.
core_metric_selection_rationale.orientation.chord_entropy_normalized: Makes chord entropy interpretable relative to the configured maximum.
core_metric_selection_rationale.orientation.phi_chord: Quantifies fourfold axial order for equally weighted edge chords.
core_metric_selection_rationale.orientation.phi_segment_length_weighted: Quantifies fourfold axial order while retaining segment length weighting.
core_metric_selection_rationale.orientation.segment_entropy_length_weigh: Measures directional dispersion while retaining curved-edge segment geometry and length weighting.
Makes segment-weighted entropy interpretable relative to the configured maximum.
core_metric_selection_rationale.topology.component_count: Confirms network connectedness and the analyzed component scope.
core_metric_selection_rationale.topology.cycle_rank: Measures independent cycles and verifies controlled route redundancy.
core_metric_selection_rationale.topology.dead_end_proportion: Captures the share of terminal nodes in a size-comparable form.
core_metric_selection_rationale.topology.degree_3_proportion: Captures three-way junction composition in a size-comparable form.
core_metric_selection_rationale.topology.degree_4_proportion: Captures four-way junction composition associated with grid structure.
core_metric_selection_rationale.topology.mean_degree: Summarizes junction connectivity independently of edge geometry.
core_metric_selection_rationale.topology.node_count: Defines graph order and is a direct topology-control check.
core_metric_selection_rationale.topology.physical_edge_count: Defines graph size without counting reciprocal OSMnx arcs.

figures.provenance: Phase 7H view of stored Phase 7F summary

historical_methodology_note: Earlier approximate outputs (orientation entropy 1.5144 and phi 0.9966) are retained only as historical results. Their insufficiently aligned/documented methodology makes them not directly comparable with the explicit Phase 7G chord and segment-length-weighted baselines; the Phase 7G methodology is current.

metric_families.geometric_morphology: Derives directly from planar physical geometry and may change between geometric realizations.
metric_families.geometry_weighted_network: Uses physical edge length as graph cost and may change when geometry changes on fixed connectivity.
metric_families.orientation_morphology: Describes axial street orientation under the fixed Phase 7G binning and weighting definitions.
metric_families.topology_controlled: Depends only on graph connectivity/topology and should remain identical when frozen topology is maintained.
